title: RedLens Sky Atlas — PostHog dashboard spec

notes: Cookieless: persistence=sessionStorage, person_profiles=never → PostHog has NO Person records.
Treat 'unique users' as unique SESSIONS: use math 'unique_session' ($session_id), not 'dau'.
No IP / no geo: $geoip_* and $ip are never present; do not build geo tiles.
$current_url is a relative path (e.g. /atlas?id=...). Domain is the 'host' super property.
Every event carries super properties: product, host, environment, app_commit, atlas_commit.
mcp_tool_call is captured server-side (src/server/posthog-capture.ts), not by posthog-js. distinct_id AND the
mcp_session property are the echoed/minted Mcp-Session-Id header (src/server/index.ts) — same value for every
call in one agent run, for MCP clients that honor the header (most do; the official SDK client does).
Clients that don't get a fresh id per call, indistinguishable from a real one-call session. Never use
'dau'/person-based math (person_profiles is disabled for this event too); 'unique_session' math on
distinct_id approximates unique agent runs but undercounts true unique callers when the header isn't honored.

superProperties.product: reader | search | radar | reports | preview | chat | mcp | other
superProperties.atlas_commit: live atlas sha at event time

props.action: 0 | 1 | 2 (target rung level the pendulum click lands on)

props.kind: linked_doc | cited_by | relation | relation_source | glossary | glossary_source

props.params: object — the exact tool call arguments (query, id, address, filters, …); truncated past 2000 chars of JSON
props.client_name: string? (from the MCP initialize handshake, e.g. 'claude-ai', 'ask-atlas')
props.mcp_session: string|null (echoed/minted Mcp-Session-Id; same value across one agent run for compliant clients)

dashboards.name: Product Overview
dashboards.description: Top-level traffic, health, and release impact.

dashboards.name: Atlas Content Insights (normalized)
dashboards.description: What's popular, corrected for the fact that scopes differ drastically in size.

tiles.name: Scope popularity — views per doc (normalized)
tiles.question: Average views per doc in each scope; corrects for scope size.
tiles.query: SELECT properties.scope_title AS scope, count() AS views, any(toFloat(properties.scope_total_docs)) AS docs, round(count() / any(toFloat(properties.scope_total_docs)), 2) AS views_per_doc FROM events WHERE event = 'doc_view' AND properties.environment = 'prod' AND properties.scope_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters} GROUP BY scope HAVING docs > 0 ORDER BY views_per_doc DESC

tiles.name: Over/under-represented scopes (view-share vs doc-share)
tiles.question: ratio > 1 ⇒ scope draws more attention than its share of docs.
tiles.query: WITH totals AS (SELECT count() AS total_views, any(toFloat(properties.atlas_total_docs)) AS total_docs FROM events WHERE event='doc_view' AND properties.environment='prod' AND properties.scope_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT properties.scope_title AS scope, count() AS views, any(toFloat(properties.scope_total_docs)) AS docs, round((count() / (SELECT total_views FROM totals)) / (any(toFloat(properties.scope_total_docs)) / (SELECT total_docs FROM totals)), 2) AS disproportion FROM events WHERE event='doc_view' AND properties.environment='prod' AND properties.scope_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scope ORDER BY disproportion DESC

tiles.name: Doc-type appetite (normalized)
tiles.question: Views per existing doc, by document type.
tiles.query: SELECT properties.doc_type AS doc_type, count() AS views, any(toFloat(properties.doc_type_total)) AS docs, round(count() / any(toFloat(properties.doc_type_total)), 2) AS views_per_doc FROM events WHERE event='doc_view' AND properties.environment='prod' GROUP BY doc_type ORDER BY views_per_doc DESC

tiles.name: Co-viewed scopes per session
tiles.question: Which scopes get explored together within one session.
tiles.query: SELECT scope_a, scope_b, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT $session_id, arrayJoin(arrayDistinct(groupArray(properties.scope_title))) AS scope_a, arrayJoin(arrayDistinct(groupArray(properties.scope_title))) AS scope_b FROM events WHERE event='doc_view' AND properties.environment='prod' GROUP BY $session_id) WHERE scope_a < scope_b GROUP BY scope_a, scope_b ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 25

dashboards.name: Reader Engagement
dashboards.description: How people interact with the reader.

dashboards.name: Search Quality
dashboards.description: Search usage, result relevance, and click behavior.

tiles.name: Top queries
tiles.query: SELECT properties.query AS query, count() AS searches FROM events WHERE event='atlas_search' AND properties.environment='prod' GROUP BY query ORDER BY searches DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Top failing queries (0 results)
tiles.query: SELECT properties.query AS query, count() AS searches FROM events WHERE event='atlas_search' AND properties.environment='prod' AND toInt(properties.result_count) = 0 GROUP BY query ORDER BY searches DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Search mode pill clicks
tiles.question: How often users explicitly switch broad/phrase/strict via the pills (vs. typing quotes).

tiles.name: Most-used filter values
tiles.query: SELECT properties.report AS report, coalesce(properties.value, properties.slug) AS value, count() AS uses FROM events WHERE event='report_filter' AND properties.environment='prod' AND properties.active = true GROUP BY report, value ORDER BY uses DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Report exports
tiles.question: Who downloads the data — a strong 'this report is useful' signal.

tiles.name: Most-explored history commits
tiles.query: SELECT properties.agent_slug AS agent, properties.pr AS pr, properties.commit AS commit, count() AS opens FROM events WHERE event='radar_history_toggle' AND properties.environment='prod' AND properties.open = true GROUP BY agent, pr, commit ORDER BY opens DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Constellations engagement (removal candidate)
tiles.question: Does anyone actually use the constellations graph (single node-select probe)? Feeds the keep/remove decision.

dashboards.name: Preview / Review Funnel
dashboards.description: Fork-review usage, including what people type into the preview box.

tiles.name: Unparsed inputs (parser backlog)
tiles.query: SELECT properties.input AS input, count() AS attempts FROM events WHERE event='preview_submit' AND properties.environment='prod' AND properties.parsed = false GROUP BY input ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Trust-gate outcome
tiles.question: On the unreviewed-fork interstitial, do people proceed or back out?

tiles.name: Reuse vs fresh entry
tiles.question: Do people re-open a recent preview or submit a new one.

tiles.name: Where chat is used
tiles.query: SELECT properties.path AS path, count() AS messages FROM events WHERE event='chat_message_sent' AND properties.environment='prod' GROUP BY path ORDER BY messages DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Starter prompt usage
tiles.question: Do the canned starters get used, and which ones.

tiles.name: Sign-in conversion
tiles.question: Of sessions that open chat, how many click sign-in (then send).

tiles.name: Citation clicks
tiles.question: Do users click through the atlas citations the agent returns.

dashboards.name: MCP Usage
dashboards.description: What MCP clients call, what they ask for, and whether it works — server-captured (src/server/posthog-capture.ts), no session/user identity.

tiles.name: Calls by client
tiles.question: Which MCP clients (Claude Desktop, ask-atlas, custom integrations, …) are actually using this.

tiles.name: Error rate by tool
tiles.query: SELECT properties.tool AS tool, countIf(properties.ok = false) AS errors, count() AS calls, round(countIf(properties.ok = false) / count(), 3) AS error_rate FROM events WHERE event='mcp_tool_call' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY error_rate DESC

tiles.name: Top atlas_search queries
tiles.question: What people are actually trying to find — the direct signal for refining atlas content and search/MCP tooling.
tiles.query: SELECT properties.params.query AS query, count() AS calls FROM events WHERE event='mcp_tool_call' AND properties.tool='atlas_search' GROUP BY query ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Top atlas_get lookups
tiles.query: SELECT properties.params.id AS id, count() AS calls FROM events WHERE event='mcp_tool_call' AND properties.tool='atlas_get' GROUP BY id ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Recent errors
tiles.query: SELECT timestamp, properties.tool AS tool, properties.error AS error, properties.params AS params FROM events WHERE event='mcp_tool_call' AND properties.ok = false ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Result size by tool (median bytes)
tiles.question: Are any tools returning payloads big enough to be worth trimming.

tiles.name: Calls per agent run
tiles.question: How many tool calls a single agent session makes and which tool sequences are common — depends on the MCP client honoring Mcp-Session-Id.
tiles.query: SELECT properties.mcp_session AS session, count() AS calls, groupArray(properties.tool) AS tools FROM events WHERE event='mcp_tool_call' AND properties.mcp_session IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Agent runs over time
tiles.question: Unique agent sessions per day, via uniq(distinct_id) — undercounts if a client doesn't echo the session header (person_profiles is off, so trends 'unique_session'/'dau' math don't apply here).
tiles.query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, uniq(distinct_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE event='mcp_tool_call' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

tiles.name: Top exception messages
tiles.query: SELECT properties.$exception_message AS message, count() AS count FROM events WHERE event='$exception' AND properties.environment='prod' GROUP BY message ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 50
